second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 11 + Average 7 + Difficulty 7 = 25), pdf 14; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-25 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-10, II 11-14, III 15-17, q18 own heading, IV 19-22, V 23-24, q25 own heading); answer side keys 1-24 (key '4.' printed after a stray '2.' — '2. 4. A) Yellow'; IV printed twice, q23-24 under 'IV.'), q25 restated not keyed. BLUE PRINT 11/7/7 = 25 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 25.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 14 (heading, LO 2, BLUE PRINT; q1-3) 15 (q4-10) 16 (q11-19) 17 (q20-25). A side 'Key Answer: Lesson no 2 Green Wealth' pdf 99 (keys 1-22), pdf 100 (23, 24, restated q25). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: Kannada lines dropped (Q side Unicode Kannada; key lines carry Kannada glued after the English on the same line — cut off). Nothing Kannada stored.

Sections by printed order: s1 I mcq q1-10; s2 II match q11-14 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III T/F q15-17 (answer blanks removed from text, kept in text_as_printed); s4 q18 'Classify …' printed on its own numbered line with its own header '3x1=3'; s5 IV q19-22; s6 V q23-24; s7 q25 draw, own numbered line with header '3x1=3'. Types by key form: one sentence/list -> vsa (q19, q21, q22, q23), 2+ sentences -> sa (q20, q24); q18 three labelled lines -> sa (3 steps; 'Creepers' line wraps once).

MARKS (R-E9): s1 '10 X 1=10' (10 q) -> 1; s2 '4 X 1=4' (4 q) -> 1; s3 '3x1=3' (3 q) -> 1; s5 '4*2=8' (4 q) -> 2; s4 '3x1=3' over 1 q, s7 '3x1=3' over 1 q -> null; s6 '2 X 3=6' (2 q) -> null because M=3 is not the smaller factor (R-E9 as written; flagged in the reason).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag' (BLUE PRINT 11/7/7 totals only). quota_table difficulty_only; second method = table total 25 (agrees).
LO (R-E10): lesson LO row 2 on every question, lo_source 'lesson_table' (text_as_printed verbatim incl. the printed cedilla glyphs).

KEYS: q6 '6. Tree' prints no letter -> option C by pass-1 match (source_correction). q7 'Aracanut' prints no letter and matches no option (option C 'Ada' is the same Kannada word) -> null + 'key text not among options' (addendum §4.4; review-blocking). q8 'A) Desert' for papaya -> 'printed key contradicts fact' (the stem's Kannada line names a cactus). Match q12 'plants and herbs' vs 'Herbal class', q13 'Broad-oblong leaf' vs 'Broad, long leaf' flagged. q25 draw: no key -> empty + 'no answer printed'.
Source typos kept verbatim: 'Plant– Herb', 'Ada', 'Lotus-hair', 'Shurbs', 'Pumpkinvine', 'peepletree', key 'Peeple tree'.
FIGURES: none on pdf 14-17, 99-100 (pdfimages, pdfplumber). TOPIC evs-3-02-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
